# Audio credits (generated by tools/audio/audio_build.py, do not edit by hand)

All recordings and music are **CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication)** or, for the orchestral / choral music below,
**public domain recordings of public domain compositions** (Public Domain Mark / CC0 set by the performer or
publisher on the source item). No AI-generated audio. Processing (cutting, filtering, pitch, layering, loop
crossfades, loudness) is done by tools/audio/audio_build.py. Licences are taken from each pack's `meta.json`
written by the downloader (page + archive licence file); where an author offers several licences (e.g. OGA-BY 3.0
or CC0) the game uses the CC0 one. Freesound items are the site's HQ previews. Credit is not required for
CC0 / public domain but given here.
